redTeam.question: If an attacker gets code execution in this pod, can they escalate to the node or the cluster?
evidence: not evaluated, so this scenario cannot be called mitigated: KN-S038, KN-S039, KN-S001, KN-S005, KN-S009, KN-S010, KN-S020, KN-S021, KN-S022, KN-S023, KN-S025, KN-S002, KN-S003 (1 object not audited (pods are in a kind kube-noob has no reader for))
redTeam.blastRadius: Privileged containers, host namespaces/paths, dangerous capabilities and broad RBAC each turn a single compromised pod into node or cluster takeover.
safeguards: automountServiceAccountToken: false; least-privilege Roles without wildcards
RHACS/StackRox deploy-time enforcement of the matching default policies

redTeam.question: Can secrets leak through manifests, Git history, env dumps or mounted tokens?
evidence: not evaluated, so this scenario cannot be called mitigated: KN-S013, KN-S014 (1 object not audited (pods are in a kind kube-noob has no reader for))
redTeam.blastRadius: Literal credentials end up in Git, CI logs and `oc get -o yaml`; mounted SA tokens give API access to any attacker with RCE.
safeguards: rotate any credential that was ever committed

redTeam.question: Can a traffic spike or memory leak take down neighbours or trigger restart storms?
evidence: not evaluated, so this scenario cannot be called mitigated: KN-C004, KN-C005, KN-C006 (1 object not audited (pods are in a kind kube-noob has no reader for))
redTeam.blastRadius: Unbounded memory triggers node OOM kills of unrelated pods; BestEffort pods are evicted first; aggressive liveness probes amplify slowness into restarts; a manifest that sets spec.replicas under an HPA scales the workload back down on every apply, peak or not.
safeguards: requests + memory limits on every container
liveness checks only the process; failureThreshold >= 3
no spec.replicas on a workload an HPA scales; minReplicas sets the floor

redTeam.question: Could a different (malicious or broken) image run than the one that was reviewed?
evidence: not evaluated, so this scenario cannot be called mitigated: KN-S012 (1 object not audited (pods are in a kind kube-noob has no reader for))
redTeam.blastRadius: Mutable tags can be re-pushed; rollbacks become non-deterministic and scans/signatures no longer apply to what runs.
safeguards: RHACS 'Latest tag' and image-signature policies in enforce mode
